forbidden_shortcuts: No DB insertion of executable PHP/JS.
No direct edit of ionCube-protected IranKala files.
No blind caching of cart/checkout/session-sensitive pages.
No aria-hidden/tabindex hacks that break interactive controls.
No plugin/theme broad deactivation as a performance shortcut.

unlock_options.description: Supported IranKala vendor update/hook exposes the needed renderer fixes.
Explicitly authorize a narrow, reviewable code-deployment action in keshavarz20-git-ops for only the listed accessibility/performance targets.

execution_sequence: Run mobile performance checks on home/PDP/calculator/cart/checkout.
If runtime upgrade is part of the wave, run staging compatibility and payment/checkout smoke before production.
Only then mark Wave1 PASS and re-run dependency gates for Phases21/22/23.
